extension.description: Enjoy full episodes of GMA Network shows for free! This is not an official GMA addon.
extension.news: v2.0.0 (21/11/2026) [new] Menus read from GMA Play (gmanetwork.com moved its full episodes to GMA Play) [new] Movies and public affairs shows [new] GMA Play Home sub menu and By Category menu [new] My View History menu, watched flags, Go to the show [new] Ready-made catalog installed on a first installation or an update from 1.x [change] Update Catalog loads only the new shows (about a minute instead of hours) [change] Views and history kept apart from the catalog (not lost when it is reset) [change] Faster menus: lists kept in cache, sort methods and content types [change] Dependencies six, requests and inputstreamhelper no longer needed [fix] Episode thumbnails, empty images and views not saved [fix] Search with an apostrophe, Reload Catalog and the Tools actions
